review_rules: A developer describing an earlier design intention does not rewrite the released artifact; store intention and shipped evidence separately.
Retcon is an analytical label requiring explicit before/after evidence rather than any apparent contradiction.
Cut content is evidence for development history, not automatically for the released continuity.
Statements about canon are attributed to their speaker and date rather than promoted into a universal repository rule.
Use these sources to explain provenance changes and design evolution, not to erase contradictory historical evidence.
